shots.name: 05-choose-your-look.png
shots.check: document.body.innerText.includes('Choose your look') ? 'first-visit dialog' : 'NO DIALOG (use a fresh browser profile)'

shots.name: continue
shots.js: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Continue'); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'ok' })()

shots.name: 01-train-dark.png
shots.js: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.rz-nav-btn')].filter(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.trim().endsWith('Model'))[0]; if (!b) return 'not found'; b.click(); return 'ok' })()

shots.name: 04-wizard-goal.png
shots.js: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('.q-stepper__tab *')].filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null && e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'Start')[0]; if (!el) return 'not found'; el.closest('.q-stepper__tab').click(); return 'ok' })()

shots.name: 04-monitor.png
shots.check: document.body.innerText.includes('no job yet') ? 'idle, no job' : 'JOB PRESENT?'

shots.name: open-dataset
shots.js: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null && e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'landscapes')[0]; if (!el) return 'no demo dataset'; el.click(); return 'ok' })()

shots.name: 07-dataset.png
shots.js: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null && e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'Look consistency filter')[0]; if (!el) return 'none'; el.scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); window.scrollBy(0, -150); return 'ok' })()
